items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Billy, uh-huh, with Duke, he would make that his home.

ctx.x: Billy, uh-huh, with Duke, he would make that his home. And then he'd get drunk we'd put him under the piano and let him sleep it off, because we'd be there til 5:00 the next morning. And Parker, Charlie Parker, he used to come out quite often, when he was in town, when he was working at the Rum Boogie. Yeah.
So -- Clark Terry, they were in the Navy at the time, and he used to come out, and they used to -- I don't know how those sailors did it. They were --
